question: In the year 1940, the national games were hosted by which of the following cities?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Bombay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **National Games** were initiated as the Indian Olympic Games, with the aim of promoting sports culture in India.
 
• In the year **1940**, the National Games were hosted in **Bombay**, which is now known as **Mumbai**.
 
• **Bombay** was a major hub for sports and cultural activities during the pre-independence era due to its vibrant cosmopolitan environment.
 
• The National Games were significant as they provided a platform for Indian athletes to showcase their talent and prepare for international competitions, including the **Olympics**.
 
• Historically, Bombay has contributed immensely to sports in India, including **cricket**, **hockey**, and other disciplines.
 
• The event played a crucial role in spreading awareness about sports and building a sense of national pride during the colonial period.

• **Lahore**__

 __
 
• **Lahore** is a city in present-day **Pakistan** and was an important cultural and sporting center during British India.
 
• However, the city did not host the National Games in 1940.
 
• Lahore is known for its contributions to sports such as **hockey** and **cricket** and is home to many historic sporting venues.
 
 
 
• **Lucknow**__
 __
 
• **Lucknow**, located in the Indian state of **Uttar Pradesh**, is known for its rich **cultural heritage** and historical landmarks.
 
• The city has hosted various sporting events but was not the host of the National Games in 1940.
 
• Lucknow is famous for sports like **badminton**, as it is the birthplace of the sport’s pioneer, **Syed Modi**.
 
 
 
• **Patiala**__
 
 
• **Patiala**, located in the state of **Punjab**, has a rich tradition of sports and is home to the **National Institute of Sports (NIS)**.
 
• While Patiala has been a significant contributor to Indian sports, it did not host the National Games in 1940.
 
• The city is known for its focus on **athletics** and has produced many renowned athletes.
